title: Pin rules
description: Which pins may not share a net, and how near a no-connect mark stands to a pin to be on it.

$schema.description: the schema this file is written to

noConnectReach.description: how near a no-connect mark must stand to a pin to be on it, in the sheet's units

kinds.description: how each kind of pin is said, by its word

conflicts.description: the kinds that may not meet on a net, and how much their meeting weighs

items.description: Two kinds of pin that may not meet on a net — the same kind twice when two of it may not —, and its weight.

between.description: the two kinds of pin, by their words — the same word twice for two of one kind

severity.description: how much it weighs: error or warning
